supported: Initial-thread SIGUSR1/2 disposition, raise, default termination, ignore
Same-signal coalesced pending raise during handler
Validated executable handler/trampoline and user stack; restored saved GPR/FP/FS state
not_implemented: SIGINT SIGTERM SIGPIPE SIGALRM native process-directed delivery
Worker signal delivery and cross-signal nesting
negative_behavior: kill/sigprocmask fail ENOSYS; unsupported registration/raise fail EINVAL; workers/cross-signal nesting fail ENOSYS
native_validation: Existing full suite signal case covers registration, delivery, pending, default/ignore, context restoration and worker rejection. New py4-contracts case verifies process kill/masking rejection.
kernel_review: A real async signal change requires generation-qualified target selection, per-group/per-thread pending/masks, validated return frames and interruptible-wait coordination outside unsafe locks. This is an independent kernel milestone; no scheduler delivery changes added.
